meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 它会组织一个5人安全小组(3名猎手、2名PoC工程师)并行审计代码:分头找可疑漏洞,分析根因,再用最小示例验证能否真实利用,最后给出带结论和严重程度的审计报告。
howto.when: 提到'security-research'、'security review'、'vulnerability audit'等关键词,或要求做安全审查、漏洞研究、上线前安全检查等时触发。

say.text: 对当前仓库做安全审计,评估漏洞可利用性。
审查这个diff,找出可被利用的安全问题。
say.note: 聚焦变更文件并验证可利用性。

say.text: 验证这个漏洞能否真实利用,给出最小PoC。
say.note: PoC工程师会尝试复现该漏洞。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a 5-member team (3 hunters, 2 PoC engineers) to audit code in parallel, verify exploitability with minimal PoCs, and produce a verdict report (PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK) with severity ratings and residual risk.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'security-research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', or requests for security review, vulnerability research, or pre-release checks. Also via '/security-research'.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on the current repo and assess exploitability.
Review this diff for exploitable security issues.
say_en.note: Focuses on changed files and verifies exploitability.

say_en.text: Can this vulnerability actually be exploited? Provide a minimal PoC.
say_en.note: The PoC engineers will try to reproduce it.
